adjusted_prescription: To improve the agent's ability to safely navigate starting near the top row when fires cluster in the middle, provide a corrective demonstration that clearly shows committing to the safe top-edge corridor path. This demonstration should begin at the top-left corner and move rightward along the top row, avoiding steps near fire by staying on safe, fire-free cells, then descending to the goal near the top edge. It is important to show consistent movement along this corridor without backtracking or detours into risky fire-adjacent spots, even when local observations might suggest otherwise. Including variants with goals slightly shifted along the top edge and minor within-corridor detours will help the agent generalize this safe traversal pattern in different fire layouts. This targeted approach will fill the current gap in demonstrations and teach the policy to avoid unsafe paths by trusting the top-edge corridor strategy when starting near the top row amid central fires.
